verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly confirm multi-state support: companies can have multiple work locations across states with different pay schedules, platform handles multi-state tax requirements, federal/state tax configuration for employees, and automatic tax calculation/filing across federal, state, and local jurisdictions. Community feedback also affirms strong payroll tax handling as a core strength. Missing for 10: no detailed walkthrough of state-specific registration workflow (e.g., new state registration steps) or independent verification of accuracy across all 50 states.
